description: Record and apply one migration (name + SQL) in a single transaction, then reload the REST API's schema cache. It is linted first: a table without row level security is blocked. dry_run: true only lints. Destructive SQL needs confirm: true and the destructive scope (production:destructive on production). On production without production:destructive, a confirmed destructive migration waits for the project's production approver: the reply is status approval_required with an approval_id; wait with approvals_wait. Scope: database:write.

confirm.description: true only after the user approved the destructive operation

dry_run.description: Only lint and plan; change nothing

organization_id.description: Organization id, e.g. `acme`. Default: the token's.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. `todo-app`. Default: the last one used, or your only one.

version.description: Version number; default is the current UTC time as YYYYMMDDHHMMSS

name: migrations_apply
title: Apply a migration
